correctness.rationale: The cyclic S/P/L block decomposition exhausts all maximum induced-degree-one subsets. The identity m=2|D|+s+ell+e proves the optimum. Bounded defect enumerations count every maximum, the explicit local changes prove the connectivity trichotomy and sun/cycle models, and the bounded-radius local exchange case table gives exact degrees and edges. The standalone verifier checks exhaustive subsets 7..16 and all predicted optimal exchanges 7..32 plus longer spot checks. The proof, rather than finite extrapolation, supports all m>=7.

evidence: The previously recorded cycle-power theorem classifies maximum independent-set exchanges with a mod-three defect budget; its objects induce degree zero.

value.rationale: A nontrivial natural optimum-solution graph for degree-one induced subgraphs has exact four-periodic disconnection versus connectivity, including the sun graph at residue one and precise degree strata in the residue-two case. The result addresses both complete classification and accessibility of all optima, which the scalar dissociation number does not settle.
